titulo: Cuantificadores: much, many, a lot of, some, any
resumen: Decir cuánto hay: mucho, poco, algo, nada. Todo depende de si la cosa se puede contar.

teoria.paraQue: Para hablar de cantidad sin dar un número: cuántos clientes, cuánto tiempo, mucha gente, poca información, algo de café, nada de dinero. Y para preguntar cuánto: how much / how many.
teoria.llave: La llave es una pregunta: ¿puedo contarlo? Si puedo ponerle -s (one email, two emails), es contable → many, a few, how many. Si no (time, money, information), es incontable → much, a little, how much. A lot of y some / any sirven para los dos.

formulas.ejemplo: We have ((a lot of)) clients in Cali. · We don't have ((many)) clients in Cali.
We have ((a lot of)) work. · We don't have ((much)) time.

formulas.formula: a few + plural · a little + singular
formulas.ejemplo: I have ((a few)) friends here. · I have ((a little)) time.
There's ((some)) coffee. · There isn't ((any)) coffee. · Is there ((any)) coffee?

formulas.formula: How many + plural · How much + singular
formulas.ejemplo: ((How many)) emails do you get? · ((How much)) money do we have?

reglas: Contable: lleva -s en plural y acepta números (two clients, three meetings) → many, a few, how many.
Incontable: no lleva -s ni a/an (information, advice, money, time, work, news, feedback, equipment) → much, a little, how much.
A lot of (o lots of) sirve para los dos y es lo normal en afirmativa: I have a lot of work. Much en afirmativa suena raro.
Much y many se usan sobre todo en negativa y pregunta: We don't have much time. How many people came?
People es plural aunque no lleve -s: There ARE a lot of people / many people. Nunca «much people».
Some en afirmativa; any en negativa y pregunta. Excepción: some en ofrecimientos y peticiones (Would you like some water? Can I have some water?).
A few (algunos, no muchos) va con contables; a little (un poco) con incontables.
Para contar un incontable usa un partitivo: a piece of advice, a cup of coffee, a bottle of water, a bit of information.
News es incontable y singular: The news IS good.
Work (trabajo en general) es incontable; job (puesto) es contable: a lot of work, two jobs.

usos.ejemplo: We don't have ((much)) milk. Do we need ((any)) bread?

usos.uso: Hablar de tiempo libre y dinero
usos.ejemplo: I have ((a little)) time on Saturday, but not ((much)) money.
I have ((a lot of)) meetings and ((too many)) emails this week.

usos.uso: Pedir y dar información al cliente
usos.ejemplo: We need ((some)) information about the target. Can you give us ((a few)) examples?
((How much)) budget do we have? ((How many)) days do we need?

errores.mal: There is much people in the meeting.
errores.bien: There are a lot of people in the meeting.
errores.porque: People es plural: there are + many / a lot of. Much es para incontables.

errores.mal: I have many work this week.
errores.bien: I have a lot of work this week.
errores.porque: Work es incontable: much (negativa) o a lot of (afirmativa), nunca many.

errores.mal: She gave me some good advices.
errores.bien: She gave me some good advice.
errores.porque: Advice es incontable: no lleva -s. Para contarlo: a piece of advice.

errores.mal: I don't have some time today.
errores.bien: I don't have any time today.
errores.porque: En negativa va any, no some.

errores.mal: We have a few time before the call.
errores.bien: We have a little time before the call.
errores.porque: Time es incontable: a little. A few es para plurales.

errores.mal: How much emails do you get?
errores.bien: How many emails do you get?
errores.porque: Emails es contable plural: how many.
News es incontable y va en singular aunque termine en -s.

contraste.nota: A few + plural; a little + incontable.

contraste.b: There isn't ((any)) coffee in the kitchen.
contraste.nota: Some en afirmativa; any en negativa y pregunta.

frases.en: There's a lot of traffic today.
We need more information about the target.
frases.es: Necesitamos más información sobre el público objetivo.

frases.en: Can I give you a piece of advice?
We got a lot of feedback from the client.
There are too many meetings this week.

teoria.tip: Si le puedes poner -s, es contable → many / a few / how many. Si no, es incontable → much / a little / how much. Y people ya es plural: there ARE a lot of people.

ejercicios.q: How ___ emails do you get every day?
ejercicios.explica: Emails es contable plural: how many.

ejercicios.q: There ___ a lot of people in the meeting.
ejercicios.explica: People es plural: there are. «Hay» no se dice con have.

ejercicios.q: We don't have ___ time.
ejercicios.explica: Time es incontable y la frase es negativa: much. Some no va en negativa.

ejercicios.q: Can you give me ___ advice about the client?
ejercicios.explica: Advice es incontable: some advice. Nunca an advice ni a few advice.

ejercicios.q: How ___ money do we have for the campaign?
ejercicios.explica: Money es incontable: how much.

ejercicios.q: I have ___ friends in Medellín.
ejercicios.explica: Friends es plural: a few. A little es para incontables.

ejercicios.q: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
ejercicios.explica: Negativa → any. Some es para afirmativa; «isn't no» sería doble negación.

ejercicios.q: Would you like ___ coffee?
ejercicios.explica: En ofrecimientos se usa some aunque sea pregunta.

ejercicios.q: We didn't receive ___ feedback from the client.
ejercicios.explica: Feedback es incontable y la frase es negativa: much.

ejercicios.q: There ___ too much work this week.
ejercicios.explica: Work es incontable: there is.

ejercicios.q: We only have ___ time before the pitch, so let's focus.
ejercicios.explica: Time es incontable: a little. A few y few son para plurales.

ejercicios.q: The client gave us ___ useful information.
ejercicios.explica: Information es incontable: some information. Nunca a / an information.

ejercicios.q: How ___ people are coming to the party?
ejercicios.explica: People es plural: how many people.

ejercicios.q: I need ___ new equipment for the studio.
ejercicios.explica: Equipment es incontable: some equipment (o a piece of equipment).

ejercicios.q: How ___ clients do we have in Bogotá? (much / many)
respuestas: many
ejercicios.explica: Clients es contable plural: how many.

ejercicios.q: There ___ a lot of people at the gym tonight. (is / are)
respuestas: are
ejercicios.explica: People es plural: there are.

ejercicios.q: We don't have ___ information about the target. (much / many)
respuestas: much
ejercicios.explica: Information es incontable: much en negativa.

ejercicios.q: I only have ___ minutes before my next meeting. (a few / a little)
respuestas: a few
ejercicios.explica: Minutes es plural: a few.

ejercicios.q: Would you like ___ water? (some / any)
respuestas: some
ejercicios.explica: Ofrecimiento: some, aunque sea pregunta.

ejercicios.q: I didn't get ___ sleep last night. (much / many)
respuestas: much
ejercicios.explica: Sleep es incontable: much en negativa.

ejercicios.q: Can I give you a ___ of advice? (piece / cup / slice)
respuestas: piece
ejercicios.explica: Advice es incontable; para contarlo: a piece of advice.

ejercicios.q: There isn't ___ coffee left. (some / any)
respuestas: any
ejercicios.explica: Negativa: any.

ejercicios.q: How ___ time do we need for the presentation? (much / many)
respuestas: much
ejercicios.explica: Time es incontable: how much.

ejercicios.es: Hay mucha gente en la oficina hoy.
ejercicios.en: There are a lot of people in the office today.
ejercicios.explica: People es plural: there are + a lot of. Ni is ni much.

ejercicios.en: How many clients do you have?
ejercicios.explica: Clients es contable: how many.
Time es incontable y la frase es negativa: much.
Ofrecimiento: some. Coffee aquí es incontable, sin a.

ejercicios.es: Tengo unos pocos amigos en Cali.
ejercicios.en: I have a few friends in Cali.
ejercicios.explica: Friends es plural: a few.

ejercicios.en: How much money do we have for the campaign?
ejercicios.explica: Money es incontable: how much, y nunca lleva -s.

ejercicios.es: El cliente nos dio algunos consejos útiles.
ejercicios.en: The client gave us some useful advice.
ejercicios.explica: Advice es incontable: some advice, sin -s y sin an.

ejercicios.frase: There is much people in the meeting.
correccion: There are a lot of people in the meeting.
There are many people in the meeting.
There are lots of people in the meeting.
ejercicios.explica: People es plural: there are + a lot of / many. Much es para incontables.

ejercicios.frase: I have many work this week.
correccion: I have a lot of work this week.
I have lots of work this week.
ejercicios.explica: Work es incontable: a lot of work. Many solo con plurales.

ejercicios.frase: She gave me some good advices.
correccion: She gave me some good advice.
ejercicios.explica: Advice es incontable: no lleva -s.

ejercicios.frase: We don't have many clients in Cali.
ejercicios.explica: Clients es plural y la frase es negativa: many es correcto.

ejercicios.frase: I need some informations about the brand.
correccion: I need some information about the brand.
ejercicios.explica: Information es incontable: nunca lleva -s.

ejercicios.frase: I don't have some time today.
correccion: I don't have any time today.
ejercicios.explica: En negativa va any, no some. O bien: I have no time.

ejercicios.frase: There are a few minutes left before the call.
ejercicios.explica: Minutes es plural: a few minutes. Correcta.

ejercicios.frase: There are a lot of people in the office.
respuestas: There aren't many people in the office.
There are not many people in the office.
ejercicios.explica: En negativa, con plural: not many.

ejercicios.frase: We have a lot of time.
respuestas: We don't have much time.
We do not have much time.
ejercicios.explica: Time es incontable: en negativa, not much.

ejercicios.frase: There is some coffee in the kitchen.
respuestas: Is there any coffee in the kitchen?
ejercicios.explica: Pregunta: any. There is → Is there.

respuestas: How many people are coming to the meeting?
How many people are going to come to the meeting?
How many people are going to the meeting?
How many people come to the meeting?
How many people will come to the meeting?
ejercicios.explica: People es plural: how many people.

ejercicios.es: No tenemos mucha información sobre el cliente.
respuestas: We don't have much information about the client.
We don't have a lot of information about the client.
We do not have much information about the client.
We don't have much information on the client.
ejercicios.explica: Information es incontable y sin -s: much en negativa.

respuestas: Would you like some water?
Do you want some water?
Would you like any water?
Do you want any water?
ejercicios.explica: Ofrecimiento: some (any también se oye, pero some es lo natural al ofrecer).

ejercicios.es: Tengo poco tiempo y muchos correos.
respuestas: I have little time and a lot of emails.
I have a little time and a lot of emails.
I have little time and many emails.
I have a little time and many emails.
I have little time and lots of emails.
I have a little time and lots of emails.
ejercicios.explica: Time es incontable (little / a little); emails es plural (a lot of / many).
Cinco incontables del trabajo: nunca llevan -s ni a/an.
Partitivos: así se cuenta lo incontable.

ejercicios.texto: There are a lot of people in the office today.
respuestas: There are a lot of people in the office today.
ejercicios.explica: People es plural: there are + a lot of.

ejercicios.texto: We don't have much time, but we have a few good ideas.
respuestas: We don't have much time, but we have a few good ideas.
We do not have much time, but we have a few good ideas.
We don't have much time but we have a few good ideas.
ejercicios.explica: Much con time (incontable); a few con ideas (plural).

ejercicios.consigna: Describe tu semana de trabajo con cantidades: cuántas reuniones, cuánto tiempo, cuántos correos, cuánta información tienes del cliente nuevo.
ejercicios.objetivo: many / much / a lot of / a few / a little con contables e incontables
ejercicios.ejemplo: I have a lot of meetings this week and very little time. I get many emails every day, but I don't have much information about the new client.
ejercicios.explica: Meetings y emails se cuentan (many, a lot of); time e information no (little, much).

ejercicios.consigna: Recibe a un cliente en la agencia: ofrécele algo de tomar y pregúntale cuánto tiempo tiene y cuántas personas vienen de su equipo.
ejercicios.objetivo: some en ofrecimientos · how much · how many
ejercicios.ejemplo: Would you like some coffee or some water? How much time do you have today? And how many people are coming from your team?
ejercicios.explica: Some para ofrecer; how much con time (incontable); how many con people (plural).
